item.title: Houdiscert Registration Disabled
item.description: Houdiscert registration has been disabled thanks to someone spam creating accounts.
item.content:encoded:
Houdiscert Registration Disabled

Recently, the register page on houdiscert.com has been disabled. This is to prevent people from spam creating accounts again. If you would like to create a new account, or if you account was mistakenly deleted in purging the spam accounts, you can email houdert6@gmail.com or houdert6@proton.me and request an account to be created. This is a temporary measure, and it will eventually be replaced with better protections against spam.
